goal: Push weekly PnL toward ~€1000 on a €20k Bitvavo book without breaking WR edge

window.method: bar-close replay; refill_on_exit=false (bar refill hurts); weekend entries off; AlphaI sparse until ~2026-09-07

verdict.note: Best OOS/full pack raises mean week ~€471→€692 and median ~€115→€411. Only ~18% of weeks print ≥€1000; that is a fat right tail (esp. mid-Aug), not a typical week. Densifying hours, loosening excess, longer trails, or continuous 15m scan did not unlock €1k median.

recommended.name: wr_util50_p3
recommended.live_micro_note: While book is still ~€4k keep clip ≈€1300–€2000. Only scale clip to ~50% of book when Bitvavo capital is actually ~€20k. Do not hardcode €10k on the micro book.

rejected_hotter.name: clip15k_p2
rejected_hotter.why: Higher mean (+€738) and 27% weeks ≥€1k, but median drops vs util50 and max DD worsens to about -€1525 / worst week about -€1314.
